answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a signal bet on surviving 104 epochs of grading, and every nebula settlement recomputes the tide schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 104 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
